description: Defines an abstract class ResourceLoader for dynamically loading resources using specified resource loader classes, including caching mechanisms and XML configuration parsing.

classes.name: ResourceLoader
classes.description: An abstract class for loading resources with dynamic class instantiation, XML configuration, and caching.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Loads a resource as InputStream using a specified loader.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a resource using a specified loader.

methods.name: getLoader
methods.description: Retrieves a ResourceLoader instance based on XML filename and loader name, utilizing cache.

methods.name: readXmlRootElement
methods.description: Reads and returns the root element of an XML document.

methods.name: invalidateDocument
methods.description: Clears cached XML documents related to a filename.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML document from classpath.

methods.name: makeLoader
methods.description: Creates a ResourceLoader instance from an XML element configuration.
